hotelADR.publisher: Greater Victoria Hotel Development Working Group (Destination Greater Victoria with BC Hotel Association, City of Victoria and others), final report, hosted by BCHA, April 2026
hotelADR.quote: Victoria saw some of the most significant Average Daily Room Rate (ADR) growth across Canada in 2025 - with the average daily room rate jumping from $200 in 2024 to $224 in 2025.
hotelADR.notes: Read from the PDF text. The report does not name the data vendor for this sentence; its adjacent inventory chart is labelled 'CoStar Data'. Occupancy for 2025 reported elsewhere as 79.9% (victoriabuzz.com citing Destination Greater Victoria), not confirmed on a primary page. Note: assets-corporate.visitvictoria.com 'Victoria Accommodation Monthly Summary' PDFs are Victoria, Australia (Melbourne) and were excluded.

mrdt.jurisdiction: City of Victoria (Oak Bay, Saanich, Langford, Southern Gulf Islands reported at 2%; Sidney 3% from 2025 - from search summary, not confirmed on page)

destinationFee.name: Destination Marketing Fee (DMF)
destinationFee.applies: some hotels only ('Depending on the hotel')

taxes.quote: For hotel rooms, a PST of 8%, GST of 5% and Municipal and Regional District Tax (MRDT) of 3% will be assessed. Depending on the hotel, you may be assessed an additional Destination Marketing Fee (DMF) of 1% as well.

hostelDormBed.notes: Hostelworld displayed the price in USD. The only hostel listed for Victoria on that page. Corroborating range on the hostel's own blog (oceanisland.com, 2026-07-01): 'roughly $40-$60/night depending on the season' for a downtown dorm bed; currency not stated, CAD implied. HI Victoria: its HI Canada page returned 404 and no price was read on HI's own site; third-party 'from US$36' figures were not confirmed.

gaps: No full-year ADR read from CBRE, CoStar/STR directly, or Statistics Canada; the $224 figure is from the DGV/BCHA working-group report.
